site1.notes: Existing PNTR domain belongs to Site 1. Do not reassign it to Site 2 or Site 3.

site3.notes: If a custom/free domain is requested, provision a separate hostname; never move runner3wp.pntr.dev from Site 1.

rules: Site numbering is fixed to the mappings above unless explicitly changed and re-verified.
Before attaching a custom domain, verify the target Wasmer app and read that app/domain's current CNAME target.
Do not infer domain ownership from app creation order or stale checkpoints.
